# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backends and new APIs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and introduces Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. The new Graphite pipeline bindings land alongside a backend-neutral async ReadPixels API and a dedicated Vulkan.Silk.NET NuGet package. FreeType-backed font rendering arrives for Windows Nano Server, and several native memory leaks and allocation hot-paths are fixed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m152. Upstream m151 stability fixes from after the 4.151.0 branch point are also included. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering pipeline. Consumers can create Graphite GPU contexts for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, accessing the modern lower-overhead GPU path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async ReadPixels API lets callers read pixel data from GPU-backed images and surfaces without blocking the render thread, working across all supported GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET NuGet package** — A dedicated package wraps the Silk.NET Vulkan interop layer, making it straightforward to wire up Vulkan contexts without custom P/Invoke boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native memory leaks fixed in SKRegion, SKPixmap, and SKImage** — Three use-after-free and memory-leak fixes land: SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots the parent SKRegion to prevent native use-after-free; SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* root the pixel source; SKImage.Create on raster failure correctly releases the CoTaskMem pixel buffer. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Allocation hot-paths reduced** — GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on the null-terminated fast path, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count, SKData.SaveTo skips a double buffer copy, and HandleDictionary caches the skip-registration reflection check. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **FreeType font rendering on Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server environments lack the GDI font stack. SkiaSharp now falls back to FreeType on Nano Server, enabling text rendering in containerised Windows workloads that was previously broken. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test coverage added** — Containerised CI test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server continuously validate SkiaSharp on these production-relevant Linux and Windows container environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
